name: xWays Hoarder xSplit®

features.name: xSplit Wilds
features.description: Split everything to the left on their row.

review:
xWays Hoarder xSplit is a doomsday-prepper slot. xSplit Wilds split every symbol to their left on the same row, and xWays reveal two to four symbols, all the same if several land.

Scatters trigger Bunker Raid Spins, where xWays become sticky, and they can upgrade to super scatters. Nolimit rates it High volatility, with an 11,030x cap.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
